name: format-png
description: A fast, lossless PNG decoder and encoder for the browser and Node, compiled from Rust to WebAssembly: every color type and bit depth, metadata, chunk inspection, palette optimization and chunk stripping.
author: Yohan Sandun

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p format-png-wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/wasm ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/format_png_wasm.wasm
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:package
